title: B3: CLI and attribution surface — `orchestrator pick planner --model`, `scorecard --planner` per-goal interactive attribution and Fable share, CLAUDE.md Planner wording (P1, P5)
spec:
Why: the interactive Planner launcher (`f orch`, outside this repo) has no way to learn which model the router recommends; `orchestrator pick planner` prints only account and config_dir (cli.py:244-254). `scorecard --planner` (planner_runs.premium_summary + scorecard.format_premium_summary) shows headless and interactive totals but no per-goal attribution or Fable share although planner_telemetry.interactive_by_goal and accepted_goal_summary (merged) compute them. CLAUDE.md line 1 hard-codes 'You are the Planner (Fable 5.1)'.
What:
- cli.py: `pick` gains `--model` (store_true). With --model, after the existing account line, print a second line `model\t<model id>\t<reason>` where rcfg = planner_router.load_cfg(pool.cfg): mode "active" -> models[rcfg["default_tier"]] with reason "planner_routing active default tier <tier>"; otherwise models["planner"] with reason "planner_routing <mode>: interactive Planner stays on the escalation tier". Without --model the output is unchanged (existing test_cli assertions hold).
- planner_runs.premium_summary(days, root) gains two keys computed inside try/except Exception -> None: "interactive_by_goal" = planner_telemetry.interactive_by_goal(root=root, cfg=cfg, days=days) and "accepted_goals" = planner_telemetry.accepted_goal_summary(root=root). scorecard.format_premium_summary renders, after the interactive day totals, a block 'interactive by goal (approximate):' with one line per row 'goal <id or ->\t<tokens> tokens\t<days joined by ,>' and a line 'accepted goals: n=<n> planner tokens/goal <x> fable tokens/goal <y> fable share <z> tokens/material decision <w>' (None -> '-'); both blocks omitted when the keys are None.
- CLAUDE.md line 1 becomes: '# You are the Planner. A human approves every merge to main. Headless Planner launches pick their model through pool.toml [planner.routing] (Fable 5.1 escalation tier, Opus default candidate, shadow until evidence); the interactive session runs the model `orchestrator pick planner --model` names, Fable 5.1 today.' No other CLAUDE.md change.
- Tests: tests/test_cli.py gains the two pick cases; tests/test_scorecard.py (or tests/test_planner_runs.py where format_premium_summary is tested today) gains the format case with patched planner_telemetry functions.
acceptance: tests/test_cli.py::test_pick_planner_model_flag — `pick planner --model` prints the account line then a model line naming models.planner with a reason containing 'shadow' under the default config, and models.opus with 'active' when [planner.routing].mode is active; `pick planner` without the flag prints exactly the legacy single line

tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_premium_summary_includes_interactive_by_goal_and_accepted_goals — premium_summary under a sandbox root with planner_telemetry.interactive_by_goal and accepted_goal_summary patched returns both keys; with either raising, the key is None and the call still succeeds

tests/test_scorecard.py::test_format_premium_summary_renders_attribution_blocks — format_premium_summary prints the 'interactive by goal (approximate):' block and the 'accepted goals:' line for populated keys and omits both when they are None
tests/test_cli.py::test_claude_md_planner_wording — CLAUDE.md's first line no longer says 'Planner (Fable 5.1)' and mentions [planner.routing] and `orchestrator pick planner --model`

constraints.interface_contract: cli pick planner --model prints a second line 'model\t<id>\t<reason>' from planner_router.load_cfg; premium_summary gains interactive_by_goal and accepted_goals (None on failure); format_premium_summary renders both; CLAUDE.md line 1 reworded, nothing else in the file.

result.summary: superseded by B3 fix round (new task based on task/T-0744 via fix_round_for) whose scope adds .orchestrator/prompts/planner.md: tests/test_goals.py::test_planner_md_matches_claude_md_lists requires planner.md line 1 to equal the reworded CLAUDE.md line 1 and task scope is immutable. Work so far: commit 474ec48 on task/T-0744 (pick --model, premium_summary attribution, format blocks, CLAUDE.md wording, tests).

Implemented and committed the planner model flag, telemetry attribution, scorecard rendering, documentation wording, and acceptance tests.
